name: Sticky Stagger Cards
description: A dark split section with a sticky left intro (heading, sub, roll-hover button, social proof) beside a right column of five cards that pin at staggered tops and pile up leaving 20px lips, purely with CSS sticky.
interactions: the left intro is position:sticky top:100px; the five cards are each position:sticky with staggered tops 100/120/140/160/180px so they stack leaving 20px lips as you scroll (pure CSS, no JS transforms)
the button label rolls per-letter on hover: each letter translateY -100% with an 18ms-per-index delay, revealing its duplicate (JS splits the label into spans)
under 999px the grid stacks and cards go full width; prefers-reduced-motion disables the letter roll
